text:
michelle: Seeing cross-tenant rows in Insights for a customer after the affinity rollout. cc @devon @kevin

devon: Can you repro? production or canary?

michelle: Prod, but only in a subset of consoles. Happened right after we flipped console-routing-affinity v2 at 10:12.

kevin: Looking at proxy logs, I see requests dropping X-Tenant header for ~2s window. snippet: 'incoming headers: X-Tenant: TID-123 -> proxied headers: (none)'

sasha: This matches a bug in sidecar relay where we map session.affinity -> x-tenant but when fallbackToCookie is true we clear header. Investigating.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out console-mux v2 to 40% at 10:11:58 (id: deploy-abc123)

devon: If header cleared, telemetry will attribute metrics to default org. Can we grep telemetry for 'org:default' spikes between 10:11-10:13?

alyssa: I see abnormal spike in org:public between 10:11:50 - 10:12:30 across dashboard-queries route. Sending query now.

michelle: Repro steps I used: open Insights for Customer B, filter by runlist, observe rows from Customer A. Curl repro: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer X' -H 'X-Tenant: TID-B' 'https://console.redwood/api/insights?org=tid-b' -> response contains tid-a rows.

kevin: Quick patch idea: enforce X-Tenant passthrough at mux proxy and add assert in console-auth that tenant header != 'public' when Authorization present. Diff snippet:

if (req.headers['authorization'] && req.headers['x-tenant'] === 'public') {
  throw new Error('missing-tenant-header');
}

sasha: :thumbsup: will spike a canary with header-enforce middleware. Also add telemetry tag 'tenant.header.enforced' so we can roll back if errors.

jordan: Agree rollback if anything weird. For quick mitigation we can push a server-side filter that drops cached prefetched org-snippets when tenant mismatch detected.

alyssa: Opened a pager duty incident and flagged affected customers. Action items: (1) canary patch header-enforce (2) add telemetry tag (3) revert routing flip if errors > 0.5% in 2m. Assigning devon+kevin.

devon: Working on patch now, will post PR.

michelle: Thanks. I'll keep monitoring and share screenshots in #customer-success if it recurs.
